connection.SHVnZ2luZ0ZhY2VSZXN0Q2xpZW50..source:
A connection to the Hugging Face REST API.

Requires an API key (set as `apikey`) from [Hugging Face Settings](https://huggingface.co/settings/tokens). The connection uses the `huggingface://` URL scheme and provides access to the Hub API for models, datasets, and spaces
